title: A Categorical Archive of ChatGPT Failures

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of ChatGPT's responses to prompts requesting jokes about specific genders, as well as analyzing generated code and tables that rank or evaluate individuals based on their gender.

Qualitative analysis of ChatGPT's responses to hypothetical scenarios and requests to generate code or tables that make decisions (e.g., scientific capability, saving a life) or rank intellect based on race.
Qualitative analysis of generated code responding to prompts that ask the model to determine if a person should be tortured based on their country of origin.
Evaluating the model's ideological leanings by referencing external studies that tested the model with hundreds of political statements and evaluating its results on the Political Compass test.
